clips.title: The story
paras: Tallow sends fighters from Tarren Mill across the mountains to relieve Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands. Before reporting to Drum Fel, you prove your battle readiness against Boulderfist ogres near the ruins of Stromgarde.

In Tarren Mill, Tallow has little patience for untested fighters wandering the Foothills. While recruits stand idle, allies are under attack far away. He sends capable fighters east through Thoradin's Wall into the Arathi Highlands, where Hammerfall is besieged from several sides. Tallow wants them to prove their worth against a strong foe before he sends them to the outpost.

Tallow demands a display of strength at the ogre mound northeast of the ruins of Stromgarde. Boulderfist ogres and their enforcers hold much of Arathi, threatening travelers on the highland trails. Fighting them thins the hostile forces flanking the road and proves you can stand against the danger before reaching Hammerfall.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Weaklings... All of them. You, adventurer, what are you looking at? Think you're something special, huh? Why not prove it?
The Hammerfall outpost in Arathi's under attack. Unless we send them help soon, their demise is imminent.

But before you go rushing off, you may want to test your skills first. Northeast of Stromgarde in Arathi is an ogre mound inhabited by the Boulderfist tribe. When you can handle the ogres and enforcers there, then report to Drum Fel in Hammerfall.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I have not the time to sharpen my axe, let alone leave the outpost to slay those beasts that would try and slay my kin.
You do not seem to have the experience of a grunt let alone a full-fledged adventurer, what do you want, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: So, you think you're strong enough to help Hammerfall? So be it.

Tallow either sent you to that ogre mound in the hopes that you would kill yourself or he thinks you're strong enough to aid us. Either way, you're here now and I am in need of more soldiers in our fight against the constant attacks.
If you plan on staying in Hammerfall then get some rest, and come speak to me again when you're ready. There's no shortage of fighting to be had.
